source.title: Simple proofs of open problems about the structure of involutions in the Riordan group

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 5232843. Local resolver metadata identified the exact work as Gi-Sang Cheon and Hana Kim, "Simple proofs of open problems about the structure of involutions in the Riordan group", Linear Algebra and its Applications 428 (2008), pages 930-940, DOI 10.1016/j.laa.2007.08.027.

Access failure mode: metadata_only with network_or_dns_failure for local shell fetches. Direct shell fetching of zbmath.org, api.zbmath.org, and doi.org failed with DNS resolution errors in this sandbox. Browser recovery searched the exact zbMATH identifier, DOI, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus ScienceDirect, and title plus author names. Candidate pages inspected included ScienceDirect pages for related or citing works, Academia author-profile pages with only indexed snippets/download labels, OEIS/Oerior bibliography pages, and local OpenAlex/Crossref-derived CSV rows. These candidates were rejected because none exposed a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML technical body for DOI 10.1016/j.laa.2007.08.027.

No document map was generated because no exact-work readable PDF or full HTML primary source was recovered. Per the source adequacy rule, no questions were extracted from resolver metadata, abstracts, bibliography entries, search snippets, author-profile snippets, or citing papers.
Saved the final JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath_5232843.json and outputs/latest.json.
